invariants.rationale: At least one input element must be non-null since the method always returns one of them if either is null.
If parent is non-null, it must have a non-negative child count.
If template is non-null, it must have a non-negative child count.
If parent and its attributes are non-null, attribute map size is non-negative.
If template and its attributes are non-null, attribute map size is non-negative.
